testcase.name: Scenario: Open a main-panel menu while additional commands are visible: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-1dT1Uy/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:353:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a main-panel menu while additional commands are visible ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Options additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user opens the Highlight New drop-down in the main Options panel ✔ Then the drop-down menu appears over the additional command area ✔ And the Options additional command area remains visible behind the menu ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the drop-down menu closes ✔ And the Options additional command area remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the selected Tools tab ✔ Then the additional command area closes ✔ And the part remains visible
